title: Operations New Action Permission Consistency

items.action: make generic operation types selectable in the New Operation type picker

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.operations.create permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing operation authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; this contract covers only the generic Operations-page creation entry point.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Specialized operation wizard routes use their own canonical business permissions under separate focused contracts.

forms.reason: Operation wizard form behavior is unchanged.

notes: fair_crm.operations.create governs generic operation-type entries on OperationsPage. The New Operation picker itself can also be exposed when at least one specialized operation entry is authorized under that entry's dedicated composite prerequisites, without requiring operations.create. Unsupported or legacy /operations/new fallbacks resolve to the Operations list and remain governed separately by operations.read.
